title: MCP tools/call params
description: The `params` of an MCP `tools/call` request from the worker to the tool gateway (stateless Streamable HTTP, JSON responses, `/mcp`). Conventions around it: the run token (run-token.schema.json) goes in the `X-Run-Token` header on every request, `tools/list` included (`Authorization` is left to AWS SigV4: on AWS API Gateway checks the caller's IAM signature on `/mcp` before the gateway checks the token; locally nothing signs); the W3C `traceparent` header carries the run's trace (ADR 0022), so the gateway's spans join it; `tools/list` shows only the token's tools, with annotations per connector-allowlist.schema.json (the worker reads readOnlyHint as read_only and idempotentHint as idempotent). A successful call returns the tool's JSON result as `structuredContent` (an object; a non-object result is wrapped as {"result": ...}) and the same JSON as text in `content[0]`. A tool that fails, or gets arguments that do not match its input schema, returns `isError: true` and a text the model may read (never a credential); a refused token is HTTP 401 with a JSON-RPC error, and an unknown tool or invalid params a JSON-RPC error (-32602). Rules not expressible here: `name` is in the token's tools; for a tool in the token's require_approval, the run's approval must match `agentplatform/step`, `name` and the canonical JSON of `arguments`.

arguments.description: Tool arguments as the model gave them, checked by the gateway against the tool's input schema.

_meta.description: MCP request metadata. Platform keys use the `agentplatform/` prefix; other MCP keys (progressToken) are allowed.

agentplatform/step.description: Step number of this call in the run (the approval check compares it).

agentplatform/idempotency_key.description: The worker's key for this call: SHA-256 hex of run id, step, tool and canonical arguments. Logged by the gateway.
